name: Call Agent
description: Send a message to another agent and get its response. Use it to delegate a task to a specialized agent.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to call (see Available Agents in your instructions)

message.description: The message to send to the agent

attachment_indices.description: 0-based indices of this turn's attachments to forward, e.g. [0]. Omit when none is relevant.
